Accessibility, GNOME-native automation, and desktop backend hardening.

### Accessibility and semantic automation

- Added optional AT-SPI inspection and automation with explicit application and
  window scope, generation-safe handles, bounded redacted snapshots, and
  explicit reopen behavior.
- Added the `pf a11y` command for tree inspection and typed semantic mutations,
  including focus, actions, editable text, caret, and text selection.
- Separated machine-readable action names from localized display names.
- Corrected Unicode text insertion lengths for AT-SPI providers and certified
  representative GTK and Qt workflows.

### GNOME-native integration

- Added the bundled private D-Bus bridge for screen capture, input, windows,
  pointer observation, and clipboard capabilities.
- Added protocol negotiation, typed capability errors, atomic extension
  installation and updates, settings preservation, and explicit restart
  reporting.

### Session and backend reliability

- Hardened process-group and session teardown, cancellation, input-state
  cleanup, Wayland/X11 bounds, and transport error classification.
- Improved managed-window correlation, compositor/session routing, clipboard
  readiness, screenshot validation, and diagnostics privacy.
- Preserved explicit capability reporting and typed errors for unavailable or
  partially implemented operations.

### CLI, API, and tooling

- Added generated accessibility CLI documentation, typed capability gating, and
  synchronized CLI/API checks.
- Added conservative snapshot-size enforcement and focused protocol, race, live
  integration, AT-SPI certification, and release smoke coverage.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/nskaggs/perfuncted/compare/v1.1.4...v1.2.0)
